results.rationale: Consistency: the case shifts and its can arrangement and package lettering are altered, with an additional horizontal can introduced. Instruction: a matching upright can appears on top, but the original right-side can remains, so it is duplicated rather than moved. Quality: multiple labels are garbled, the horizontal can has distorted graphics and shape, and the upper can has an awkward contact with the stack.

Consistency: the braided trunk, leaf arrangement and woven basket remain recognizable and intact, excluding the requested poster background and decorations. Instruction: the edit adds a light-green halo gradient, floating droplets, leaf silhouettes and a clear Green Home title at top left. Quality: clean lettering, coherent plant and basket detail, and smoothly integrated decorative droplets produce a polished poster.
